purpose: Verify a file is managed as a persistent collaborative record whose contents and lifecycle trace are preserved after circulation and closed only through owner archival, not deletion
preconditions: Institute Employee A (file owner) and Institute Employee B exist with authorized roles
Employee A has created a file with a mandatory initial comment and an optional attachment
action_or_input: Employee A submits the file to Employee B; Employee B forwards or returns it with a comment; Employee A then archives the file
expected_result: The file and its accumulated comments, attachments and movement records remain stored and retrievable after circulation; no deletion occurs; the file ends in the archived state through the owner's archival action

purpose: Verify a file is a persistent composite object consisting of mandatory comments and optional attachments
preconditions: An authorized Institute Employee exists
action_or_input: Create a file with an initial comment and one attachment, then retrieve the file
expected_result: The retrieved file contains both the initial comment and the attachment as parts of one persistent file object

purpose: Verify a file remains valid as a composite object when only the mandatory comment is present and the optional attachment is omitted
preconditions: An authorized Institute Employee exists
action_or_input: Create a file with an initial comment and no attachment, then retrieve the file
expected_result: The file is created and retrieved with its comment and no attachments

purpose: Verify circulated files and their accumulated contents are preserved without deletion
preconditions: A file with a comment and an attachment has been submitted and circulated to another employee
action_or_input: Retrieve the circulated file and its contents after circulation, including after one further movement action
expected_result: The file and all accumulated comments and attachments are still retained and retrievable, with no content deleted

purpose: Verify a file owner can archive a completed file instead of deleting it
preconditions: A circulated file exists
The acting user is the file owner and the file's intended collaborative objective is complete
action_or_input: The file owner archives the file
expected_result: The file is archived and remains stored in the system; it is not deleted

purpose: Verify traceability of file creation, movement, comments, attachments and archival actions
preconditions: Employees A (owner) and B exist
action_or_input: A creates a file with a comment and attachment, submits it to B, B forwards or returns it with a comment and attachment, A archives the file, then the trace for the file is retrieved
expected_result: The retrievable trace includes the creation, movement, comments, attachments and archival actions

purpose: Verify Institute Employees operate file workflows under assigned role contexts, System Admin acts as the governance actor, and operational file processing stays with Institute Employees
preconditions: An Institute Employee with an assigned role exists
A System Admin exists
A circulated file exists
action_or_input: The Institute Employee performs a file workflow operation under the assigned role; the System Admin performs a governance operation and then attempts an operational file action
expected_result: The Institute Employee's file operation succeeds, the System Admin's governance operation succeeds, and the System Admin's operational file action is not permitted

purpose: Verify Institute Employee users, including Faculty and Staff, can use file workflows
preconditions: A Faculty user and a Staff user exist as Institute Employees with authorized roles
action_or_input: Each of the Faculty user and the Staff user performs an operational file workflow action (create a file with a comment)
expected_result: The operation is accepted for both the Faculty user and the Staff user

purpose: Verify System Admin can assign an FTS-relevant role to a user
preconditions: A System Admin exists
A target user without the role exists
action_or_input: System Admin assigns an FTS-relevant role to the target user
expected_result: The role assignment is recorded and the target user holds the assigned role

purpose: Verify System Admin can reassign an FTS-relevant role of a user
preconditions: A System Admin exists
A target user with an existing FTS-relevant role exists
action_or_input: System Admin reassigns the user's role to a different role
expected_result: The reassignment is recorded and the user holds the reassigned role

purpose: Verify System Admin can monitor FTS system usage within the governance scope
preconditions: A System Admin exists
FTS usage has occurred
action_or_input: System Admin accesses FTS usage monitoring
expected_result: System Admin can access FTS system usage monitoring information within the available governance scope

purpose: Verify System Admin can view FTS security and audit logs
preconditions: A System Admin exists
Audit records exist for file actions
action_or_input: System Admin requests the FTS security and audit logs
expected_result: The audit and security log information is viewable by the System Admin

purpose: Verify a user who is not System Admin cannot perform security and audit-log oversight
preconditions: An Institute Employee without the System Admin role exists
Audit records exist for file actions
action_or_input: The Institute Employee requests the FTS security and audit-log oversight function
expected_result: The request is denied and no security or audit-log oversight data is provided

purpose: Verify System Admin cannot create an operational file on behalf of an Institute Employee
preconditions: A System Admin exists
action_or_input: System Admin attempts to create a new operational file
expected_result: The action is blocked and no file is created

purpose: Verify System Admin cannot forward an operational file
preconditions: An active circulated file exists
A System Admin exists
action_or_input: System Admin attempts to forward the file
expected_result: The action is blocked and the file's holder and movement history remain unchanged

purpose: Verify System Admin cannot return an operational file
preconditions: An active circulated file exists
A System Admin exists
action_or_input: System Admin attempts to return the file
expected_result: The action is blocked and the file's holder and movement history remain unchanged

purpose: Verify System Admin cannot comment on an operational file
preconditions: An active circulated file exists
A System Admin exists
action_or_input: System Admin attempts to add a comment to the file
expected_result: The action is blocked and no comment is added

purpose: Verify System Admin cannot archive an operational file
preconditions: A circulated file exists
A System Admin exists
action_or_input: System Admin attempts to archive the file
expected_result: The action is blocked and the file is not archived

purpose: Verify an Institute Employee with multiple assigned roles can operate under the selected role
preconditions: An Institute Employee with at least two assigned institutional roles exists
action_or_input: The employee switches role context to one of their assigned roles and performs a file operation
expected_result: The operation is performed under the selected assigned role

purpose: Verify an authorized Institute Employee can create a file under an assigned role with a mandatory initial comment and optional attachments
preconditions: An authorized Institute Employee with an assigned role exists
action_or_input: Create a new file under the assigned role with an initial comment and an attachment
expected_result: The file is created under the assigned role containing the initial comment and the attachment

purpose: Verify an Institute Employee can create a new file under an assigned role
preconditions: An Institute Employee with an assigned role exists
action_or_input: The employee creates a new file under the assigned role with an initial comment
expected_result: A new file is created under that assigned role

purpose: Verify file creation is blocked without an initial comment
preconditions: An authorized Institute Employee exists
action_or_input: Attempt to create a new file with no initial comment
expected_result: File creation is blocked and no file is created

purpose: Verify file creation proceeds when an initial comment is provided
preconditions: An authorized Institute Employee exists
action_or_input: Create a new file with an initial comment
expected_result: The file is created with the initial comment

purpose: Verify optional attachments can be added during file creation
preconditions: An authorized Institute Employee exists
action_or_input: Create a file with an initial comment and attach an attachment during creation
expected_result: The file is created and the attachment is part of the file

purpose: Verify the pre-circulation draft lifecycle (save, edit, discard), submission into circulation, and preservation of contents
preconditions: An authorized Institute Employee exists
Another Institute Employee exists as recipient
action_or_input: Save a new file as a draft, edit it, submit it to the recipient; separately save another draft and discard it
expected_result: Drafts can be saved, edited and discarded before submission; the submitted file becomes circulated with its accumulated contents preserved and cannot be deleted

purpose: Verify a newly created file can be saved as a draft
preconditions: An authorized Institute Employee exists
action_or_input: Create a new file with an initial comment and save it as a draft
expected_result: The file is stored as a draft and has not been submitted

purpose: Verify a saved draft can be edited before submission
preconditions: A saved draft file exists, owned by the acting Institute Employee
action_or_input: Edit the draft's content and save it
expected_result: The edited content is stored in the draft and the file remains an unsubmitted draft

purpose: Verify a draft file can be discarded before submission
preconditions: A saved draft file exists that has not been submitted
action_or_input: The employee discards the draft
expected_result: The draft is discarded and no longer exists as a draft

purpose: Verify deletion of a submitted and circulated file is prevented
preconditions: A file has been submitted and circulated
action_or_input: Attempt to delete the circulated file
expected_result: Deletion is blocked and the file and its contents remain unchanged

purpose: Verify submission to another employee changes the file from draft to circulated workflow state
preconditions: A draft file exists
A recipient Institute Employee exists
action_or_input: Submit the draft file to the recipient
expected_result: The file is no longer a draft and is in the circulated workflow state

purpose: Verify comments and attachments accumulated in a file are preserved after submission
preconditions: A draft file with comments and attachments exists
action_or_input: Submit the file and then retrieve it
expected_result: All previously accumulated comments and attachments are present in the submitted file

purpose: Verify authorized forwarding and return of active files with mandatory comments, optional attachments, holder updates and chronological recording
preconditions: An active file is held by Employee B, sent by Employee A
Employee C exists
action_or_input: B forwards the file to C with a comment and an attachment; C returns it to B with a comment
expected_result: Both movements are accepted and recorded chronologically with their comments and attachments, and the current holder/pending recipient is updated after each movement

purpose: Verify an Institute Employee can send a file to another Institute Employee
preconditions: A file exists and the sender is authorized
Another Institute Employee exists
action_or_input: Send the file to the other employee with a comment
expected_result: The file is sent to the other employee

purpose: Verify a file can be sent to employees regardless of the receiver's role
preconditions: A file exists and the sender is authorized
Two receiver employees hold different roles
action_or_input: Send the file to the first receiver and send another file to the second receiver, each with a comment
expected_result: Each send is accepted irrespective of the receiver's role

purpose: Verify forwarding is blocked without a comment
preconditions: An active file is held by an authorized user
action_or_input: Attempt to forward the file with no comment
expected_result: Forwarding is blocked and file state and movement history remain unchanged

purpose: Verify returning is blocked without a comment
preconditions: A received file is held by an authorized recipient
action_or_input: Attempt to return the file to the sender with no comment
expected_result: Return is blocked and file state and movement history remain unchanged

purpose: Verify a file-movement action proceeds when a comment is supplied
preconditions: An active file is held by an authorized user
action_or_input: Forward the file with a comment
expected_result: The forwarding action proceeds and the comment is recorded

purpose: Verify an optional attachment can be added when forwarding
preconditions: An active file is held by an authorized user
action_or_input: Forward the file with a comment and an attachment
expected_result: The forwarding succeeds and the attachment is added to the file at that movement stage

purpose: Verify an optional attachment can be added when returning
preconditions: A received file is held by an authorized recipient
action_or_input: Return the file with a comment and an attachment
expected_result: The return succeeds and the attachment is added to the file at that movement stage

purpose: Verify a recipient can forward a received file to another user
preconditions: Employee B has received a file
Employee C exists
action_or_input: B forwards the file to C with a comment
expected_result: The file is forwarded to C

purpose: Verify a recipient can return a received file to the sender
preconditions: Employee B has received a file sent by Employee A
action_or_input: B returns the file to A with a comment
expected_result: The file is returned to A

purpose: Verify each forwarding action is recorded in chronological order
preconditions: A file is forwarded across at least two successive users
action_or_input: Perform two successive forwarding actions and retrieve the movement record
expected_result: Both forwarding actions are recorded in the order in which they occurred

purpose: Verify each return action is recorded in chronological order
preconditions: A file has been forwarded and then returned at least once
action_or_input: Perform a return action following a forward and retrieve the movement record
expected_result: The return action is recorded in chronological order after the preceding movement

purpose: Verify the current holder or pending recipient is updated after forwarding
preconditions: An active file is held by B
Employee C exists
action_or_input: B forwards the file to C
expected_result: The current file holder or pending recipient is updated to C

purpose: Verify the current holder or pending recipient is updated after returning
preconditions: File held by B was sent by A
action_or_input: B returns the file to A
expected_result: The current file holder or pending recipient is updated to A

purpose: Verify received and sent files are presented through Inbox/Outbox and associated users can open and act on files according to role and state until archival
preconditions: Employee A has sent a file to Employee B
The file is not archived
action_or_input: Check A's Outbox and B's Inbox, open the file from each, and B acts on the file
expected_result: The file is in A's Outbox and B's Inbox, both can open it, and B can act on it according to role and state

purpose: Verify files received by a user appear in the user's Inbox
preconditions: A file has been sent to Employee B
action_or_input: B views the Inbox
expected_result: The received file is listed in B's Inbox

purpose: Verify files sent by a user appear in the user's Outbox
preconditions: Employee A has sent a file to another employee
action_or_input: A views the Outbox
expected_result: The sent file is listed in A's Outbox

purpose: Verify users can view and open files from their Inbox
preconditions: A file is in Employee B's Inbox
action_or_input: B opens the file from the Inbox
expected_result: The file is opened and viewable by B

purpose: Verify users can view and open files from their Outbox
preconditions: A file is in Employee A's Outbox
action_or_input: A opens the file from the Outbox
expected_result: The file is opened and viewable by A

purpose: Verify a user can act on an actionable file from Inbox according to file state and authorization
preconditions: An active, non-archived file is in an authorized user's Inbox
action_or_input: The user performs a permitted action (forward or return with a comment) on the file
expected_result: The action is accepted

purpose: Verify a user cannot act on a file whose state does not permit the action
preconditions: A file has been archived and appears for an associated user
action_or_input: The associated user attempts to forward the archived file
expected_result: The action is blocked because of the file's state

purpose: Verify files remain accessible to associated users until the owner archives the file
preconditions: A file has been circulated among several users and is not archived
action_or_input: Each associated user opens the file after the file has moved on to later users
expected_result: The file remains accessible to every associated user

purpose: Verify complete chronological tracking history is maintained and viewable with required movement details
preconditions: A file with several movements exists, with comments and attachments
An associated authorized user exists
action_or_input: The associated user views the file's tracking history
expected_result: The history is complete from creation onward, chronological, and shows sender, receiver, timestamp, comments and attachments for each movement

purpose: Verify complete movement history is maintained from creation onward
preconditions: A file has been created, submitted, forwarded and returned
action_or_input: Retrieve the movement history of the file
expected_result: The history covers every event from file creation onward with no gaps

purpose: Verify sender details are recorded for each movement event
preconditions: A file with a movement event exists
action_or_input: Retrieve the movement history
expected_result: Each movement event shows the sender's details

purpose: Verify receiver details are recorded for each movement event
preconditions: A file with a movement event exists
action_or_input: Retrieve the movement history
expected_result: Each movement event shows the receiver's details

purpose: Verify timestamps are recorded for each movement event
preconditions: A file with multiple movement events exists
action_or_input: Retrieve the movement history
expected_result: Each movement event has a timestamp, and the timestamps are consistent with chronological order

purpose: Verify comments added at each movement event are recorded
preconditions: A file is moved with a distinct comment at each movement
action_or_input: Retrieve the movement history
expected_result: Each movement event shows the comment added at that event

purpose: Verify attachments added at each movement event are recorded
preconditions: A file is moved with an attachment added at a movement event
action_or_input: Retrieve the movement history
expected_result: The movement event shows the attachment added at that event

purpose: Verify any user associated with a file can view its tracking history
preconditions: A file exists with a sender, a current holder and a prior recipient
action_or_input: Each associated user requests the file's tracking history
expected_result: The tracking history is displayed to each associated user

purpose: Verify a user not associated with a file cannot view its tracking history
preconditions: A file exists
An Institute Employee exists who is not associated with the file
action_or_input: The unassociated employee requests the file's tracking history
expected_result: The request is denied and no history is provided

purpose: Verify only the owner can archive a completed circulated file and the archived state is permanent, readable, non-modifiable and non-forwardable
preconditions: A circulated file exists whose collaborative objective is complete
Owner and non-owner associated users exist
action_or_input: A non-owner attempts to archive; the owner archives; then an authorized user reads the file and a user attempts to modify and forward it
expected_result: The non-owner is blocked; the owner archival succeeds; the file is readable but cannot be modified or forwarded

purpose: Verify the file owner can archive a file
preconditions: A circulated file exists
The acting user is the file owner
action_or_input: The owner archives the file
expected_result: The file is archived

purpose: Verify users other than the owner cannot archive the file
preconditions: A circulated file exists
An associated user (e.g., current holder) who is not the file owner exists
action_or_input: The non-owner attempts to archive the file
expected_result: Archival is blocked and the file remains not archived

purpose: Verify archival is treated as completion of the collaborative file workflow
preconditions: A circulated file exists and the owner is ready to archive
action_or_input: The owner archives the file and the file state is retrieved
expected_result: The file is in the archived state indicating its collaborative workflow is complete

purpose: Verify archived files remain permanently stored and readable
preconditions: An archived file exists
action_or_input: An authorized user opens the archived file
expected_result: The archived file and its contents are stored and readable

purpose: Verify an archived file cannot be modified by adding a comment
preconditions: An archived file exists
action_or_input: A user attempts to add a comment to the archived file
expected_result: The attempt is blocked and the file is unchanged

purpose: Verify an archived file cannot be modified by adding an attachment
preconditions: An archived file exists
action_or_input: A user attempts to add an attachment to the archived file
expected_result: The attempt is blocked and the file is unchanged

purpose: Verify an archived file cannot be forwarded
preconditions: An archived file exists
action_or_input: A user attempts to forward the archived file with a comment
expected_result: Forwarding is blocked and no movement is recorded

purpose: Verify role-based and file-association authorization are enforced and ownership and audit identity are preserved across role switching
preconditions: A file exists
An associated user with multiple roles exists
An unassociated user exists
action_or_input: The unassociated user attempts to access the file; the multi-role user switches roles and acts on the file
expected_result: The unassociated user is denied; ownership and previously recorded audit history are unchanged after the role switch

purpose: Verify role-based access control blocks a file operation for a role without permission
preconditions: A user operates under a role not permitted for a given file operation
action_or_input: The user attempts the file operation
expected_result: The operation is denied and the file state is unchanged

purpose: Verify role-based access control permits a file operation for a role with permission
preconditions: A user operates under a role permitted for a given file operation
action_or_input: The user performs the file operation
expected_result: The operation is permitted

purpose: Verify a user can access only files they are authorized to view
preconditions: File F exists
User U is authorized to view F
User V is not authorized to view F
action_or_input: U and V each attempt to view F
expected_result: U can view F; V is denied

purpose: Verify a user can act only on files they are authorized to act upon
preconditions: File F exists
User U is authorized to act on F
User V is not authorized to act on F
action_or_input: U and V each attempt to act on F (e.g., forward with a comment)
expected_result: U's action is accepted; V's action is denied with no change to F

purpose: Verify file ownership is preserved when a user switches roles
preconditions: A multi-role user owns a file created under one role
action_or_input: The user switches to another assigned role and views the file's ownership
expected_result: The file's owner remains the same user

purpose: Verify audit history is preserved when a user switches roles
preconditions: A multi-role user has recorded actions on a file under one role
action_or_input: The user switches roles and the audit history is retrieved
expected_result: The previously recorded audit history is unchanged and still present

purpose: Verify sensitive actions are restricted according to assigned roles
preconditions: A user whose assigned role does not permit a sensitive action exists
action_or_input: The user attempts the sensitive action under that role
expected_result: The action is denied and system data is unchanged

purpose: Verify audit records and chronological version history are maintained for auditable file and integration actions
preconditions: Employees A and B exist
action_or_input: Create a file, add a comment and attachment, forward, return and archive it; then retrieve audit records and version history
expected_result: Audit records exist for each action and the version history is chronological

purpose: Verify an audit log is maintained for file creation
preconditions: An authorized Institute Employee exists
action_or_input: Create a file and retrieve the audit log
expected_result: The audit log contains an entry for the file creation action

purpose: Verify an audit log is maintained for comments added to files
preconditions: A file exists and a user is authorized to comment through a movement action
action_or_input: Add a comment to the file and retrieve the audit log
expected_result: The audit log contains an entry for the comment

purpose: Verify an audit log is maintained for attachments added to files
preconditions: A file exists and a user is authorized to add an attachment
action_or_input: Add an attachment to the file and retrieve the audit log
expected_result: The audit log contains an entry for the attachment

purpose: Verify an audit log is maintained for forwarding actions
preconditions: An active file is held by an authorized user
action_or_input: Forward the file and retrieve the audit log
expected_result: The audit log contains an entry for the forwarding action

purpose: Verify an audit log is maintained for return actions
preconditions: A received file is held by an authorized recipient
action_or_input: Return the file and retrieve the audit log
expected_result: The audit log contains an entry for the return action

purpose: Verify an audit log is maintained for archival actions
preconditions: A circulated file exists with the acting user as owner
action_or_input: Archive the file and retrieve the audit log
expected_result: The audit log contains an entry for the archival action

purpose: Verify file versioning is maintained through chronological file updates
preconditions: A file undergoes several updates (comment, attachment, movement)
action_or_input: Retrieve the file's recorded updates
expected_result: The updates are recorded and ordered chronologically as the file's version history

purpose: Verify required file and role notification events are triggered and handed to Fusion notification mechanisms
preconditions: Employees A and B exist
A System Admin can assign roles
action_or_input: Send, forward, return and archive a file, and assign a role
expected_result: A notification event is created for each source event and handed to the Fusion notification mechanism

purpose: Verify a notification is generated when a file is received
preconditions: A file is ready to be sent to Employee B
action_or_input: Send the file to Employee B
expected_result: A notification event for file receipt is created for B and handed to the Fusion notification mechanism

purpose: Verify a notification is generated when a file is forwarded
preconditions: An active file is held by an authorized user
action_or_input: Forward the file to another employee
expected_result: A notification event for the forwarding is created and handed to the Fusion notification mechanism

purpose: Verify a notification is generated when a file is returned
preconditions: A received file is held by an authorized recipient
action_or_input: Return the file to the sender
expected_result: A notification event for the return is created and handed to the Fusion notification mechanism

purpose: Verify a notification is generated when a file is archived
preconditions: A circulated file exists with the acting user as owner
action_or_input: Archive the file
expected_result: A notification event for the archival is created and handed to the Fusion notification mechanism

purpose: Verify a notification is generated when a role is assigned
preconditions: A System Admin and a target user without the role exist
action_or_input: Assign a role to the user
expected_result: A notification event for the role assignment is created and handed to the Fusion notification mechanism

purpose: Verify a notification is generated when a role is reassigned
preconditions: A System Admin and a target user with an existing role exist
action_or_input: Reassign the user's role
expected_result: A notification event for the role reassignment is created and handed to the Fusion notification mechanism

purpose: Verify notifications are delivered through Fusion's integrated notification mechanisms
preconditions: A notification-triggering event can occur (e.g., a file is sent)
action_or_input: Cause the notification-triggering event
expected_result: The notification is passed to the Fusion integrated notification mechanism for delivery

purpose: Verify FTS exposes file/workflow-tracking APIs to other Fusion modules under RBAC/audit controls with domain approval semantics left to the consuming module
preconditions: An authorized consuming Fusion module exists
An unauthorized consuming caller exists
action_or_input: The authorized module invokes an FTS API for workflow tracking; the unauthorized caller attempts the same
expected_result: The authorized call succeeds and is audited; the unauthorized call is denied; FTS does not apply domain-specific approval rules

purpose: Verify FTS exposes APIs to other Fusion modules for module-specific workflows
preconditions: An authorized consuming Fusion module exists
action_or_input: The consuming module invokes an FTS API for a module-specific workflow
expected_result: The API service is available and the call succeeds within RBAC and audit controls

purpose: Verify FTS exposes APIs to other Fusion modules for approval chains
preconditions: An authorized consuming Fusion module defines an approval chain
action_or_input: The consuming module invokes an FTS API to support its approval chain
expected_result: The API supports the approval chain and the call succeeds within RBAC and audit controls

purpose: Verify FTS exposes APIs to other Fusion modules for file-based request tracking
preconditions: An authorized consuming Fusion module exists
action_or_input: The consuming module invokes an FTS API for file-based request tracking
expected_result: The API supports request tracking and the call succeeds within RBAC and audit controls

purpose: Verify RBAC is applied to integrations with other Fusion modules
preconditions: A consuming module call is made on behalf of a user not authorized for the requested file operation
action_or_input: Invoke an FTS API for an operation the acting user is not authorized to perform
expected_result: The call is denied and no data is changed

purpose: Verify an integration call from an authorized user proceeds under RBAC
preconditions: A consuming module call is made on behalf of an authorized user
action_or_input: Invoke an FTS API for an operation the user is authorized to perform
expected_result: The call proceeds and the operation is carried out

purpose: Verify audit requirements are applied to integrations with other Fusion modules
preconditions: An authorized consuming Fusion module exists
action_or_input: Invoke an FTS API that performs an auditable file action and retrieve the audit log
expected_result: The audit log contains an entry for the integration-initiated action

purpose: Verify FTS does not define domain-specific approval rules of consuming modules
preconditions: A consuming Fusion module defines its own domain-specific approval policy and uses FTS APIs
action_or_input: The consuming module uses an FTS API to move a file in line with its own policy
expected_result: FTS carries out the tracking operation under its own RBAC and audit rules without defining or imposing the consuming module's domain-specific approval rules
